plugins.name: skills-toolkit
plugins.description: Toolkit for authoring and validating Claude Code skills and agents via a real script-backed check (description cap, PII, em-dash, Task* completeness, vague ask-user prose), not a self-scored rubric. Auto-invoke on 'create skill', 'validate skill', 'validate agent'.

plugins.name: terminal-setup-macos
plugins.description: Idempotent macOS terminal installer for Ghostty, Oh My Zsh, Powerlevel10k, Glow, MesloLGS Nerd Font, plus optional markdown preview and clickable-path extras.

plugins.name: update-readme
plugins.description: Type-driven README updater. Detects repo family, confirms it with the user, asks for style, audience, and depth, then generates from the matching template workflow. Auto-invoke on 'update readme' and 'refresh readme'.

plugins.name: diy-build-companion
plugins.description: Plan and run DIY builds with energy-aware work blocks, enforced breaks, and an inline child-safety veto gate. Project state lives in the build repo. Self-contained, Cowork-ready, no cross-plugin dependencies.

plugins.name: opencode-sync
plugins.description: Keep one canonical agent ecosystem usable on both Claude Code and OpenCode: generate OpenCode agents/commands/MCP from Claude sources, validate both runtimes' rules, detect drift, and ingest marketplaces or repos for OpenCode.

plugins.name: enablement-html-renderer
plugins.description: Packages finished enablement material into one self-contained HTML file where the reader toggles format: bullets, prose, visual diagram, comic, or cheat sheet. Theme-aware diagrams, a manual light/dark toggle, interleaved images, URL auto-linking, and an AI-ism voice gate.

plugins.name: prompt-auditor
plugins.description: Deterministic offline auditor for skills, agents, and prompts. Runs static checks against a directory of SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, or CLAUDE.md files and prints findings, critical then major then minor.
